# Unify live-TV channel skeleton/ghost loaders

## Context

Across the app the same `app-channel-list-item` is used to render live TV rows in M3U, Xtream, and Stalker (including the Favorites and Recent views). However, the *loading* placeholders shown above those lists are inconsistent and visibly heavier than the real rows. Specifically:

- They render with a **filled card background and a visible 1px border**, while the real item is `background: transparent` + `border: 1px solid transparent`.
- They use **`padding: 10px 12px`** and **`border-radius: 14px`** instead of the real `8px 10px 8px 12px` and `12px`, making the rows look taller.
- The skeleton **logo placeholder is `border-radius: 12px`**, but the real logo is `10px`.
- The right side shows **one tiny 18×18 round dot** instead of the real **34×34 squarish action buttons** (1–3 of them).
- Implementations diverge: M3U has its own `app-channel-list-loading-state`, Xtream has a custom `.channel-skeleton` with its own `channel-skeleton-shimmer 1.15s` animation, the unified-collection page uses a smaller 40×40/6px-radius variant, and Stalker has **no skeleton at all** (just a `mat-spinner` for pagination).

Goal: a single shared skeleton component that mirrors `app-channel-list-item` pixel-for-pixel, used everywhere a live TV channel list is loading.

## Current state — file map

Canonical reference (production row):
- [channel-list-item.component.scss](libs/ui/components/src/lib/channel-list-container/channel-list-item/channel-list-item.component.scss) — `min-height: 68px` cozy / `52px` compact, `padding: 8px 10px 8px 12px`, `border-radius: 12px`, transparent background, logo 44×44 / radius 10, action buttons 34×34 / radius 10
- [channel-list-item.component.html](libs/ui/components/src/lib/channel-list-container/channel-list-item/channel-list-item.component.html)

Existing skeleton implementations (to converge):
1. M3U — [channel-list-loading-state.component.html](libs/ui/components/src/lib/channel-list-loading-state/channel-list-loading-state.component.html) + [.scss](libs/ui/components/src/lib/channel-list-loading-state/channel-list-loading-state.component.scss). Used by `channel-list-container` for all 4 tabs (`all`, `groups`, `favorites`, `recent`).
2. Xtream live — [portal-channels-list.component.html:11-19](libs/portal/xtream/feature/src/lib/portal-channels-list/portal-channels-list.component.html) and the `.channel-skeleton*` block + `@keyframes channel-skeleton-shimmer` at [portal-channels-list.component.scss:158-252](libs/portal/xtream/feature/src/lib/portal-channels-list/portal-channels-list.component.scss).
3. Stalker live — [stalker-live-stream-layout.component.html:64-68](libs/portal/stalker/feature/src/lib/stalker-live-stream-layout/stalker-live-stream-layout.component.html) only renders a `mat-spinner` for pagination ("loading more"). **No initial-load skeleton.**
4. Unified collection (used by Favorites / Recent surfaces in shared shells) — [unified-collection-page.component.html:20-56](libs/portal/shared/ui/src/lib/components/unified-collection/unified-collection-page.component.html) renders shared `.list-skeleton-row` primitives at the wrong scale (40×40 logo, 6px radius, bottom border between rows).

Shared shimmer primitives that we keep using:
- [_skeleton.scss](libs/portal/shared/ui/src/lib/styles/_skeleton.scss) — `@keyframes skeleton-shimmer 1.2s ease-in-out infinite`. Single source of truth.

## Design — one shared skeleton row mirroring the real item

**Approach: extract a small dedicated `<app-channel-list-item-skeleton>` that mirrors `channel-list-item` 1:1, plus a thin `<app-channel-list-skeleton>` wrapper that renders N rows with deterministic per-row width variance. All three modules switch to the wrapper.**

Why not add a `loading` mode to `channel-list-item` itself: keeps the production component focused; the skeleton is a separate visual concept and we already have a working pattern for it; pixel-fidelity is achievable by sharing the exact tokens (padding, radius, gap, sizes) via SCSS.

### New: `app-channel-list-item-skeleton`

Path: `libs/ui/components/src/lib/channel-list-container/channel-list-item-skeleton/`

DOM structure mirrors [channel-list-item.component.html](libs/ui/components/src/lib/channel-list-container/channel-list-item/channel-list-item.component.html):

```
.channel-list-item-skeleton          // mirrors .channel-list-item
  .channel-content
    .channel-logo-shell-skeleton     // 44×44, radius 10 (or 38×38 compact)
    .channel-details
      .channel-name-skeleton         // 11px line, ~60–80% width
      @if (showEpg)
        .epg-title-skeleton          // 9px line, ~40–55% width
        .epg-timeline-skeleton       // optional 6px progress placeholder
  .action-buttons-skeleton           // 0–3 placeholders, 34×34 radius 10
```

Inputs (all `input()` signals):
- `density: 'cozy' | 'compact'` (default `'cozy'`) — toggles `.compact` modifier so `min-height` flips 68 ↔ 52, logo 44 ↔ 38, padding `8px 10px 8px 12px` ↔ `7px` block.
- `showEpg: boolean` (default `true`) — renders the EPG title + 6px progress placeholder, matching the real item's EPG slot.
- `actionCount: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3` (default `1`) — number of right-side 34×34 button placeholders.
- `titleWidth: number` (default `70`) and `metaWidth: number` (default `40`) — percentage widths for that row's lines, allowing the wrapper to vary them.

SCSS rules:
- Same `min-height`, `padding`, `border-radius`, `gap`, `border: 1px solid transparent`, `background: transparent` as the real item — so the skeleton row occupies the same exact box.

Inputs:
- `count: number` (default `9`)
- `density`, `showEpg`, `actionCount` — passed through

# Unify live-TV channel skeleton/ghost loaders

## Context

Across the app the same `app-channel-list-item` is used to render live TV rows in M3U, Xtream, and Stalker (including the Favorites and Recent views). However, the *loading* placeholders shown above those lists are inconsistent and visibly heavier than the real rows. Specifically:

- They render with a **filled card background and a visible 1px border**, while the real item is `background: transparent` + `border: 1px solid transparent`.
- They use **`padding: 10px 12px`** and **`border-radius: 14px`** instead of the real `8px 10px 8px 12px` and `12px`, making the rows look taller.
- The skeleton **logo placeholder is `border-radius: 12px`**, but the real logo is `10px`.
- The right side shows **one tiny 18×18 round dot** instead of the real **34×34 squarish action buttons** (1–3 of them).
- Implementations diverge: M3U has its own `app-channel-list-loading-state`, Xtream has a custom `.channel-skeleton` with its own `channel-skeleton-shimmer 1.15s` animation, the unified-collection page uses a smaller 40×40/6px-radius variant, and Stalker has **no skeleton at all** (just a `mat-spinner` for pagination).

Goal: a single shared skeleton component that mirrors `app-channel-list-item` pixel-for-pixel, used everywhere a live TV channel list is loading.

## Current state — file map

Canonical reference (production row):
- [channel-list-item.component.scss](libs/ui/components/src/lib/channel-list-container/channel-list-item/channel-list-item.component.scss) — `min-height: 68px` cozy / `52px` compact, `padding: 8px 10px 8px 12px`, `border-radius: 12px`, transparent background, logo 44×44 / radius 10, action buttons 34×34 / radius 10
- [channel-list-item.component.html](libs/ui/components/src/lib/channel-list-container/channel-list-item/channel-list-item.component.html)

Existing skeleton implementations (to converge):
1. M3U — [channel-list-loading-state.component.html](libs/ui/components/src/lib/channel-list-loading-state/channel-list-loading-state.component.html) + [.scss](libs/ui/components/src/lib/channel-list-loading-state/channel-list-loading-state.component.scss). Used by `channel-list-container` for all 4 tabs (`all`, `groups`, `favorites`, `recent`).
2. Xtream live — [portal-channels-list.component.html:11-19](libs/portal/xtream/feature/src/lib/portal-channels-list/portal-channels-list.component.html) and the `.channel-skeleton*` block + `@keyframes channel-skeleton-shimmer` at [portal-channels-list.component.scss:158-252](libs/portal/xtream/feature/src/lib/portal-channels-list/portal-channels-list.component.scss).
3. Stalker live — [stalker-live-stream-layout.component.html:64-68](libs/portal/stalker/feature/src/lib/stalker-live-stream-layout/stalker-live-stream-layout.component.html) only renders a `mat-spinner` for pagination ("loading more"). **No initial-load skeleton.**
4. Unified collection (used by Favorites / Recent surfaces in shared shells) — [unified-collection-page.component.html:20-56](libs/portal/shared/ui/src/lib/components/unified-collection/unified-collection-page.component.html) renders shared `.list-skeleton-row` primitives at the wrong scale (40×40 logo, 6px radius, bottom border between rows).

Shared shimmer primitives that we keep using:
- [_skeleton.scss](libs/portal/shared/ui/src/lib/styles/_skeleton.scss) — `@keyframes skeleton-shimmer 1.2s ease-in-out infinite`. Single source of truth.

## Design — one shared skeleton row mirroring the real item

**Approach: extract a small dedicated `<app-channel-list-item-skeleton>` that mirrors `channel-list-item` 1:1, plus a thin `<app-channel-list-skeleton>` wrapper that renders N rows with deterministic per-row width variance. All three modules switch to the wrapper.**

Why not add a `loading` mode to `channel-list-item` itself: keeps the production component focused; the skeleton is a separate visual concept and we already have a working pattern for it; pixel-fidelity is achievable by sharing the exact tokens (padding, radius, gap, sizes) via SCSS.

### New: `app-channel-list-item-skeleton`

Path: `libs/ui/components/src/lib/channel-list-container/channel-list-item-skeleton/`

DOM structure mirrors [channel-list-item.component.html](libs/ui/components/src/lib/channel-list-container/channel-list-item/channel-list-item.component.html):

```
.channel-list-item-skeleton          // mirrors .channel-list-item
  .channel-content
    .channel-logo-shell-skeleton     // 44×44, radius 10 (or 38×38 compact)
    .channel-details
      .channel-name-skeleton         // 11px line, ~60–80% width
      @if (showEpg)
        .epg-title-skeleton          // 9px line, ~40–55% width
        .epg-timeline-skeleton       // optional 6px progress placeholder
  .action-buttons-skeleton           // 0–3 placeholders, 34×34 radius 10
```

Inputs (all `input()` signals):
- `density: 'cozy' | 'compact'` (default `'cozy'`) — toggles `.compact` modifier so `min-height` flips 68 ↔ 52, logo 44 ↔ 38, padding `8px 10px 8px 12px` ↔ `7px` block.
- `showEpg: boolean` (default `true`) — renders the EPG title + 6px progress placeholder, matching the real item's EPG slot.
- `actionCount: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3` (default `1`) — number of right-side 34×34 button placeholders.
- `titleWidth: number` (default `70`) and `metaWidth: number` (default `40`) — percentage widths for that row's lines, allowing the wrapper to vary them.

SCSS rules:
- Same `min-height`, `padding`, `border-radius`, `gap`, `border: 1px solid transparent`, `background: transparent` as the real item — so the skeleton row occupies the same exact box.
- Logo placeholder uses the existing `--app-widget-header-bg` color-mix and inherits the shimmer via the same `&::after` pattern from [_skeleton.scss](libs/portal/shared/ui/src/lib/styles/_skeleton.scss). Reuse `@use ".../_skeleton" as *` to avoid duplicating the `@keyframes skeleton-shimmer`.
- Replicate the **container queries** from `channel-list-item.component.scss` (`360px`, `310px`, `270px`, `220px`) so the placeholder collapses identically when the sidebar is narrow.

### New: `app-channel-list-skeleton` (thin wrapper)

Path: `libs/ui/components/src/lib/channel-list-container/channel-list-skeleton/`

A `@for`-loop over `count` rows of the item skeleton. Owns the deterministic width arrays (today's `channelTitleWidths` and `channelMetaWidths` in [channel-list-loading-state.component.ts:22-23](libs/ui/components/src/lib/channel-list-loading-state/channel-list-loading-state.component.ts) — keep the same numbers so the visual feel doesn't change).

Inputs:
- `count: number` (default `9`)
- `density`, `showEpg`, `actionCount` — passed through

Layout: vertical stack with **no inter-row gap** (matches the CDK virtual-scroll item stacking in production lists), no row separator border. The "card surface" look used today is dropped — the real list doesn't have that, and that's the visible source of the "ghost is bigger" complaint.
